title: Portland State University (PSU)
summary: Portland State University (PSU) is a university in Portland. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with PSU.

sections.heading: What PSU is known for
paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) is a public institution known for its diverse academic offerings and large undergraduate enrollment, which totals 13,182 students. The university has an admission rate of approximately 90.87%, reflecting its inclusive approach to higher education. PSU is particularly recognized for its strong programs in business and health fields, with business programs comprising about 17.83% of the academic offerings and health-related programs making up roughly 7.42%. These areas highlight the university's commitment to preparing students for careers in dynamic and essential sectors.

sections.heading: Key strengths
paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) is a public institution with notable strengths in health and education programs. Health-related fields constitute approximately 7.42% of the university's academic offerings, reflecting a significant focus on preparing students for careers in healthcare. Education programs, while smaller in proportion, represent about 0.76% of the curriculum, indicating PSU's commitment to training future educators. These program shares demonstrate the university's dedication to serving community needs through specialized academic areas.

sections.heading: Popular majors
paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) offers a variety of popular majors, with business programs being the most prominent, accounting for approximately 17.83% of the academic offerings. Computer-related fields also attract a significant portion of students, representing about 6.34% of the programs. Health-related majors make up roughly 7.42%, reflecting PSU's emphasis on healthcare education. Public administration programs constitute around 3.36%, while education programs represent about 0.76% of the curriculum. These distributions illustrate the diverse academic interests and career paths pursued by students at PSU.

sections.heading: How to read PSU tuition
paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) tuition varies depending on residency status. In-state students pay an annual tuition of $11,679, while out-of-state students are charged $31,074. The overall cost of attendance, which includes tuition, fees, and other expenses, amounts to $21,590. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and families plan for the financial commitment associated with attending PSU.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) offers financial aid options to assist students in managing the cost of attendance. Approximately 41.65% of students receive Pell Grants, which are federal subsidies aimed at supporting low-income students. Among those who complete their programs, the median debt incurred is $20,500. For detailed information on financial aid and cost estimates, prospective students can consult PSU's official website or the College Scorecard page dedicated to the university.

paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) provides housing options for students both on and off campus, with the cost for room and board being $13,728 in either setting. This uniform pricing allows students to choose their preferred living arrangements without a difference in housing expenses. The availability of on-campus housing offers convenience and community engagement, while off-campus options provide flexibility for students seeking different living environments.

sections.heading: Portland and the PSU campus
paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) is located in the city of Portland, Oregon, within the 97201 zip code area. The university's campus is situated in the heart of Portland, providing students with access to the city's urban environment and amenities. Portland is known for its vibrant cultural scene, diverse neighborhoods, and commitment to sustainability, which complements the university's focus on community engagement and environmental responsibility. The location offers students opportunities for internships, employment, and recreational activities in a dynamic metropolitan setting.

sections.heading: Career outcomes
paragraphs: Career outcomes for Portland State University (PSU) graduates reflect a range of earnings and debt levels. The median earnings for PSU alumni ten years after entering the institution is $57,906, while the median earnings six years after entry are $46,937. Approximately 52.66% of students complete their programs within 150% of the expected time, indicating that just over half of the students graduate within three years of the standard two-year timeframe for an associate degree or six years for a bachelor's degree. Among those who complete their studies, the median debt incurred is $20,500. These figures provide insight into the financial and professional trajectories of PSU graduates.

sections.heading: Diversity
paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) exhibits a diverse student body with a gender distribution of approximately 43.83% men and 56.17% women. The racial and ethnic composition includes about 46.54% White students, 5.66% Black students, 23.21% Hispanic students, and 10.06% Asian students. This demographic mix reflects PSU's commitment to fostering an inclusive campus environment. Additionally, around 41.65% of the student population receives Pell Grants, indicating a significant portion of students come from lower-income backgrounds. These diversity metrics highlight PSU's role in providing accessible education to a broad spectrum of students.
